entities.summary: Amina Zidani is a French boxer competing in the featherweight division. She won the gold medal in the women's featherweight event at the 2023 European Games held in Poland. She won one of the bronze medals in the featherweight event at the 2023 IBA Women's World Boxing Championships held in New Delhi, India.
